title: An afternoon at the museum
summary: A visit focused on contemporary art and photography.
body:
Spent the afternoon exploring a photography exhibition and picked up a few ideas about framing and light. The first room was all portraits, printed far larger than life, and standing close enough to see the grain changed what they were about entirely.

The second room was quieter: landscapes, most of them taken in the hour before sunrise, and every one of them made me want to be somewhere else at five in the morning. I stayed there longer than I meant to and had to hurry the rest.

Walked home the long way afterwards, past the canal, trying to look at ordinary things the way that first room had taught me to look at faces. It did not entirely work, but it was a good walk.

title: Morning run by the river
body: Cool air, quiet paths, and a good pace. The best way to start a Tuesday.
